name: std::shared_ptr<T>::operator[]
intro:
Index into the array pointed to by the stored pointer.

The behavior is undefined if the stored pointer is null or if idx is negative.

If T (the template parameter of shared_ptr) is an array type U[N], idx must be less than N, otherwise the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the idx-th element of the array, i.e., get()[idx].

sections.title: Remarks
sections.text: When T is not an array type, it is unspecified whether this function is declared. If the function is declared, it is unspecified what its return type is, except that the declaration (although not necessarily the definition) of the function is guaranteed to be legal.

summary: Index into the array pointed to by the stored pointer.
